weft_review.scope: Read-only review of the current revision-3 set-algebra authority, inherited WR1-WR8 and revision-2 finite-collection request. File hashes identify mutable worktree inputs; the observed HEAD is not asserted to contain uncommitted adoption changes. No Weft source/configuration/qualification/handover edits; plans-folder coordination only.

decisions.shared_interface: The same qualified protocol-2 stdio services for Weft and agents; no VM/opcodes/recipe endpoint or direct database fallback.
decisions.identity: Realm/kind-qualified logical identities plus exact immutable revisions/material, selectors and profiles. Preserve historical namespaces; no universal UUID replacement.
decisions.aliases: CitationTableGeneration is distinct from RequestGeneration and session incarnation. Export full durable bindings; short aliases are not proof identities.
decisions.local_weft_nodes: Weft owns local binding/hypothesis/atom/model/trace IDs. Cross-session references qualify them by exact artifact identity and schema; Writfold does not allocate their local IDs.
decisions.artifacts: Raw source SHA256, domain-separated Writfold blob digests, producer/profile identities, logical evidence IDs and validation receipts remain distinct. Retention is not admission.
decisions.assessment: Preserve complete applicable Writfold dimensions and dependency identities; neither support nor stored assets become classical facts without a qualified bridge.
decisions.distribution: Owner-landed pinned shared contract artifact or exact source revision with schema/canonicalization identities and conformance vectors; no mutable sibling checkout build dependency.
decisions.transport: Honor 65536-byte frame ceiling; large artifacts need a qualified bounded transfer/selection contract bound to exact object, length, integrity and scope.
decisions.finite_collections: Exact authorized cut/query/interpretation/domain identity, typed ordered members and independent member/dependency assessments; materialization, measured coverage and presentation remain distinct. Candidate/top-k sets are not authoritative exhaustive universes. Unknown enumeration is not empty; identities and counts are permission-aware.
decisions.large_artifacts: Weft local reports may reach 16777216 bytes; the ordinary frame ceiling remains 65536 bytes. Qualified generic bounded selection/transfer with object/length/integrity/order/scope/completeness is required before exposing large artifacts; no oversized request or Weft-private endpoint.
decisions.set_algebra_ownership: Weft owns union/intersection/difference/membership/subset interpretation. Shared captured reads must retain complete operand dependencies and member assessments even when computation removes every member or a comparison can short-circuit; absence remains relative to the exact supplied authorized domain. This adds no Writfold algebra endpoint or writer.

requirements.current_boundary: Requires qualified ledger/intake and owner-defined procedure/start/admission schemas.

adopted_regressions: wrong object kind or same-spelled ID in another realm
changed immutable revision, evidence role, selector or profile
expired alias table and stale transport reply treated independently
multiple requests against one unchanged citation-table epoch
reconnect requires exact restored mapping or durable-reference resolution
missing/denied retained closure never substituted by HEAD or empty bytes
raw SHA256 cannot substitute for a domain-separated blob/material digest
incomplete discovery cannot become a complete quantifier domain
report copied to another subject/procedure/repository vector refuses reuse
lost acknowledgement recovers the original request/operation identity
stored report, hypothesis or activity row cannot self-admit or authorize effects
finite materialization and exhaustive authorized domain are distinct from top-k candidate discovery
duplicate values cannot erase failed references or independently required member assessments
unknown enumeration differs from exhaustive empty enumeration and cannot disclose unauthorized counts
every collection and continuation retains exact query/context/release/interpretation/domain identity
an over-frame report/model requires bounded artifact transfer, never truncation or a larger protocol frame
successful transport initialization cannot turn a symbolic Weft report into grounded or authorized output
empty algebraic results and removed members do not erase captured operand dependencies, failures, observations or independent required assessments
storage_blocker: P01O/WF24 retained relocation failure remains; no rerun, workaround, alternate backend or service claim.

prior_reviews.scope: Read-only review of owner-requested WR1-WR8 and current design/report files. Mutable Weft work may advance; these hashes identify only this review.

control_contract.scope: Transport/session control only. Contract definition and implementation are not a qualification receipt; actual source-bound evidence is indexed separately.

component_alignment_review.scope: Real pinned Weft client against newly qualified Writfold, plus exact Splicery candidate/report handoff. Not persistent owner grounding, full WR1-WR8 or effect authority.

production_method_scope: Qualified transport-control-only profile; no authenticated corpus, grounding, editing, artifact or effect methods.
